第71章 大鱼落网，奖励爆棚-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

顾承安把车缓缓停在武警警戒线前方三米左右的位置。

车没有熄火，一个身着深色便装的男子已经从队列后方走了过来，三十出头，平头。

他面容冷峻，眼神锐利，步伐匀速，那种从骨子里透出来的纪律感——一看就是体制内淬炼了多年的老手。

是个行动好手！

对方走到驾驶位车窗外，没有开口说话。

顾承安见状立马报了一组验证编码。

对方听完后，也报了一组编码。

双方核对无误。

顾承安下车，走到后排，拉开车门。

马克·西蒙——不，此刻更准确的称呼应该是“货物”——安安静静地躺在后座上，双手双脚扎带绑得结结实实，还处于深度麻醉状态。

“人在里面。”顾承安侧身让出视野，“具体情况上面应该会安排的。

我就一句话——这位是真正的硬茬，受过系统的训练，意志力强，反应速度快，我制服他的时候他还能在乙醚捂脸的情况下撑了快三十秒，别大意。”

便装男子看了一眼后座上的人，点了下头。

然后转身朝身后打了个手势。

两名武警上前，动作干脆利落地把人从后座里抬了出来，放上一副早就准备好的担架，固定好，抬着往院子深处走了。

顾承安站在原地看着担架消失在尽头，心里对这帮人的效率颇为满意。

专业的事交给专业的人，世界才能正常运转，他也不是那种非要全程盯着不放心的性格——你疑人不用，用人不疑，既然组织把接收任务交给了这支队伍，那就说明他们靠得住。

更何况，这地方——

他扫了一眼四周，水泥高墙，铁丝网，各种探头的密度很高，还有荷枪实弹的武警站岗，整个院落从外面看是个不起眼的办公楼，进来之后的配置够关一头恐龙了。

在这种地方，是龙你也得盘着，是虎你也得卧着。

兰博进了这儿也得跪。

顾承安没再多留，他朝便装男子点了下头，算是告别，重新上车，关门，挂挡，原路驶出大院。

院门口的栏杆紧接着落下。

车子驶上一段路后，顾承安拐进一条辅路，先关掉了中网爆闪和车顶警灯的开关。红蓝光熄灭，夜色重新把车辆吞没。

顾承安按下车牌转换开关，随后车子又变成了那个普普通通的鹏A212。

Gu Chengan slowly parked his car about three meters in front of the armed police cordon.

The car didn't turn off. A man in dark casual clothes had already walked over from the back of the queue. He was in his early thirties and had a crew cut.

His face is stern, his eyes are sharp, his pace is even, and he has a sense of discipline that comes from his bones - at first glance, he looks like a veteran who has been tempered in the system for many years.

He is a master of action!

The other party walked to the driver's side window and did not speak.

Upon seeing this, Gu Chengan immediately reported a set of verification codes.

After the other party listened, he also reported a set of codes.

Both parties verified that everything is correct.

Gu Chengan got out of the car, walked to the back seat, and opened the door.

Mark Simon—no, the more accurate name at this moment should be "cargo"—was lying quietly in the back seat, his hands and feet tied tightly with cable ties, and he was still in a state of deep anesthesia.

"The people are inside." Gu Chengan turned sideways to let out the view, "The specific situation should be arranged by the above.

Let me just say one thing - this guy is a real tough guy. He has received systematic training, has strong willpower and quick reaction speed. When I subdued him, he could last for almost thirty seconds with ether covering his face. Don't be careless."

The man in civilian clothes glanced at the person in the back seat and nodded.

Then he turned around and gestured behind him.

Two armed police officers stepped forward, lifted the person out of the back seat in one swift movement, placed a stretcher that had been prepared long ago, fixed it, and carried the person deeper into the yard.

Gu Chengan stood there and watched the stretcher disappear at the end, feeling quite satisfied with the efficiency of this group of people.

Only when professional matters are left to professional people can the world run normally. He is not the kind of character who has to watch and worry the whole time - you don't trust people, but you don't trust them when you employ them. Since the organization has handed over the reception task to this team, it means that they are reliable.

What's more, this place——

He glanced around. There were high cement walls, barbed wire fences, a high density of various probes, and armed police standing guard with guns and ammunition. The entire courtyard looked like an inconspicuous office building from the outside. Once inside, the configuration was enough to lock up a dinosaur.

In a place like this, you have to coil up even if it’s a dragon, and you have to lie down even if it’s a tiger.

Even Rambo has to kneel down when he enters here.

Gu Chengan didn't stay any longer. He nodded to the man in plain clothes as a farewell, got in the car again, closed the door, put the car in gear, and drove out of the compound on the same road.

The railing at the entrance of the courtyard fell immediately.

After the car drove for a while, Gu Chengan turned into a side road and first turned off the switches for the central grid flasher and the roof warning light.The red and blue lights went out, and the night engulfed the vehicle again.

Gu Chengan pressed the license plate switch, and then the car turned into the ordinary Peng A212.
